aesthetic_concept: A Letterboxd-inspired Knowledge Repository. Deep slate backgrounds with vibrant, hyper-functional color accents (green stars, orange likes) mapped strictly to reading logs and PDFs. The UI feels like an elite archive.

rules.headings: Use tight letter spacing (`tracking-tight`). Outfit provides a geometric, cinematic feel that looks great in uppercase or title case. Do not exceed `text-5xl` for main hero headings.
rules.body: IBM Plex Sans offers high legibility for dense reading materials, notes, and AI summaries. Use `text-base` or `text-sm` with `leading-relaxed`.

colors.rules: Never use pure black (`#000000`). Use `#14181C` as the absolute floor. Accents are purely functional and should not be used as generic background gradients.

spacing_and_layout.general: Follow the 'Control Room' dense grid for the 'Readings' grid page. Use Generous Spacing (`py-12` or `py-16`) between major horizontal sections on the home/detail pages.
spacing_and_layout.diary_list_view: Mimic the Letterboxd Diary list: A flat grid row layout. Col 1 (w-16): Month/Year label. Col 2 (w-12): Day. Col 3: Cover Thumbnail + Title (bold) + Year (muted). Col 4: Rating Stars (Green) + Like Heart (Orange) + Review Icon (Blue). Add a 1px `border-b border-[#2C3440]` to separate rows.
spacing_and_layout.readings_grid_view: Dense grid layout (`grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-5 lg:grid-cols-6 lg:gap-4 gap-2`). Cover image spans the full width of the cell, aspect ratio 2:3. Rating stars are centered closely below the cover.
spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Use flat solid backgrounds (`bg-[#1B2228]`). Use 1px subtle borders (`border-[#2C3440]`) and no heavy shadows for a crisp, technical look. Only add soft drop-shadows on hover for book covers.

components_blueprint.navigation: Sticky top header, `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#14181C]/90 border-b border-[#2C3440]`. Logo left, Navigation Links center, 'Log a Reading' CTA right.
components_blueprint.pdf_cover: Aspect ratio 2:3 (standard book proportions). `rounded-md`, `border border-[#2C3440]`. On hover: scale up slightly (`-translate-y-1`) with `ring-2 ring-[#00E054]/50`. This applies to both Diary thumbnails and Grid View.
components_blueprint.pdf_upload_flow: Use Shadcn Dialog. Central drag-and-drop zone (`bg-[#1B2228] border-dashed border-2 border-[#2C3440]`). Show an AI processing skeleton loader while the synopsis is generated.
components_blueprint.reading_detail_hero: Two-column split. Left: Large Cover Image. Right: Title, Author, Date Logged, Ratings, and Action Buttons (Like, Review, Log). Use a heavily blurred, darkened version of the cover image as the background hero banner (`opacity-20`).
components_blueprint.reading_detail_tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs. Override standard styling to match the dark theme (`bg-[#1B2228]`, active text `#FFFFFF`, active border bottom `#00E054`). Tabs needed: 'Synopsis' (AI), 'Topics Checklist', 'AI Notes' (generated from checklist), 'My Highlights', 'Quiz'.
components_blueprint.flashcard_revision: Aspect-video card for spaced repetition highlights. `bg-[#1B2228] border border-[#2C3440] rounded-lg`. Centered large text. Must include a 'Flip' animation using Framer Motion (`rotateY`). Action buttons below for 'Hard', 'Good', 'Easy'.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Cards lift `-translate-y-1`. Icons scale up `scale-110` and brighten on hover.
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Use `transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out` on all interactive elements.
motion_and_interaction.flashcard_flip: Use `framer-motion` to animate `rotateY` from 0 to 180 degrees based on flipped state.

icons.usage: Use filled variants for active states (e.g., filled green stars, filled orange hearts). Use regular variants for inactive states.

testing_attributes.rules: ALL interactive and informational elements MUST have a `data-testid`. Examples: `data-testid='diary-row-item'`, `data-testid='rating-star-3'`, `data-testid='like-button'`, `data-testid='upload-pdf-btn'`, `data-testid='flashcard-flip-btn'`, `data-testid='ai-checklist-item'`.

image_urls.description: Abstract multicolored lines on dark background. Use as a placeholder cover for logged PDFs.
Hand holding tablet in dark moody setting. Use for the 'Upload PDF' empty state banner or revision dashboard header.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using standard React (.js extension) and Tailwind CSS. DO NOT use .tsx files.
Run `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge` before starting.
Implement the 'Diary' view exactly as a list using a flex/grid row layout per entry, NOT standard cards. Align columns strictly like a ledger.
Implement the 'Readings' view as a tight grid of 2:3 aspect ratio covers, focusing purely on visual density.
Use Shadcn UI for Tabs (reading detail page), Checkbox (AI topic checklist), and Dialog (upload flow). Customize Shadcn components to remove Vercel aesthetics and apply the custom dark hex codes.
Build a distinct 'Revision' module. Flashcards must use Framer Motion for physical flip interactions.
Remember to inject `data-testid` on EVERY interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, grid items).
